title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Models for High-Quality MR-to-CT Synthesis for Head and Neck Proton Treatment Planning
tldr_zh: I2SB 配对桥做头颈 MR→CT，46 例训练 1–3 步即胜 pix2pix/nnU-Net，像素 MAE 降 5 HU 但 gamma 仅升 0.1 pp
tldr_en: I2SB-style paired bridge for head-and-neck MR-to-CT; 1-3 steps beat pix2pix/nnU-Net on MAE/Dice, yet proton gamma pass rate improves by only 0.1 pp.
key_numbers: DSBM 1-step MAE 73.00 HU already close to 3-step 72.30; 50-step 73.29 (Table 1)
Mean dose error Dose>90%: DSBM 3-step 0.33±0.30% vs pix2pix 0.37±0.25% (Table 2)
